chainFacts.says: Token-2022 mint 7LWan…xdRQGn, 6 decimals. One key, DZ7j2YLDq7847t2HtCWaDQUTpLJ4BinPGsY8w9Aai63y, is mint authority, freeze authority, mint-close authority, permanent delegate (it can move or burn any balance) and transfer-hook authority. A second key, EMMxaez3JFNMRFdKZgnC3KtZck6gmSS4n6AMHXUMvPZL, holds the pause authority (not paused), the transfer-fee config and withheld-fee authorities and the confidential-transfer authorities. Metadata pointer and metadata update authority: 532g6pYdfV5fx1CK4AuTHVjdYrTiq2AZfpu4Jk4rVJLb.

Extensions present: mint close authority, permanent delegate, default account state (the read did not record the default state), transfer fee config, confidential transfer mint and fee config, transfer hook with no hook program set, metadata pointer, pausable config and token metadata.

outside.says: Non-US eligible investors onboarded by Circle, from $100,000, in USDC, subject to cutoffs, liquidity and published subscription, redemption and performance fees. No independent redemption route is established and no redemption was tested.
Circle describes wallet allowlisting and transfer controls; the Solana mint shows a permanent delegate and pause. Which terms authorise their use was not reviewed.
Investor priority and recovery depend on the fund's Cayman constitutional documents, which were not reviewed.
Yield accrues through the token price; the dealing price is the fund's NAV under its offering terms.

verdict.summary: A fund share with a mirrored register fits the declaration, register-entry, holds and valuation types in outline. Which record prevails, the share as a registered holding and fund units need proposals, and the Solana mint is Token-2022. Every party behind Circle is unnamed: Circle speaks for the fund, and the administrator, custodian, auditor and regulator publish nothing in the sources.
